subject: general
question: As on April 2022, the Indian Constitution contains __ __ Articles, with 12 Schedules.
solution:
The correct answer is** '__448__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Originally the constitution contained** 395 articles divided into 22 parts and 8 schedules.** At present, there are **448 articles** in **25 parts and 12 schedules**.
 
• The number of articles has since increased to 448 due to 100 amendments.
 
• The numbering still remains the same but as and when the constitution is amended, new articles are added below original articles with** suffixes** **A, B, C **etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This schedule was added by the 74th Amendment Act of 1992.
 
• There are **12** Schedules in the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Constitution has a** preamble and 470 articles, **which are grouped into 25 parts. With 12 schedules and five appendices, it has been amended 105 times; the latest amendment became effective on 15 August 2021.
